Democrats and Republicans came together to pass the ROAD to Housing Act because it's based on what works: cutting red tape, rewarding results, lowering costs.

As Governor, I’ll build on it, speeding up permitting, using surplus state land and vacant buildings, and working with the private sector to build more homes. Because lowering costs starts with more housing.

Northern Minnesota’s small businesses are facing an incredibly difficult season. The Boundary Waters are one of Minnesota’s greatest treasures — and the outfitters, restaurants, hotels, and shops that depend on them need real support.

As Minnesota’s governor, I would do everything to help communities hit by disasters and, in the long haul, expand tourism across Minnesota, cut red tape, and open new markets for businesses.

posts.text:
Great to be in Rosemount today with business leaders and a bipartisan group of elected officials at the opening of Minnesota’s first sustainable aviation fuel blending facility at Flint Hills.

Minnesota is leading the way in sustainable aviation fuel. I've worked across the aisle to expand sustainable aviation fuel infrastructure and strengthen support for this growing industry. That's good for our farmers, our economy, and the future of aviation.

posts.text:
The murderer of Melissa and Mark Hortman was sentenced today to prison for the rest of his life. We're grateful that John and Yvette Hoffman—who courageously survived multiple gun shot wounds—are still with us and our hearts are with Colin and Sophie Hortman and everyone whose lives were forever changed by this tragedy.

Nothing can undo the pain as heard in the victims’ statements today. Melissa and Mark's legacy of service, kindness, and always showing up for others will be forever with us.
